title: Expression grammar is JavaScript, not =now()
description: The updateMetadata action with evaluate:true treats value as a JavaScript expression. The current reference docs show =now() which is a Dataview convention, not Meta Bind syntax. Correct: value: "new Date().toISOString()"

title: JS action precise interface
description: JSButtonAction: type='js', file (vault-relative path), args? (Record<string,unknown>). Script receives context.args, context.buttonConfig, context.buttonContext. Requires JS Engine plugin + JavaScript enabled.

title: InlineJS action interface
description: InlineJSButtonAction: type='inlineJS', code (string). Same context object. Supports YAML multiline strings.

title: Input field syntax and types confirmed
description: INPUT[type:bindTarget] syntax confirmed. 20+ input types available. Bind targets: propName, scope['name'], file#prop, memory^prop. Arguments in parentheses.

title: Button block syntax with action/actions mutual exclusivity
description: meta-bind-button block with YAML. action and actions are mutually exclusive. Fields: label, style, icon, class, cssStyle, backgroundImage, tooltip, id, hidden. Inline: BUTTON[id] or BUTTON[id1,id2,id3].

title: View field expression grammar uses MathJS
description: VIEW fields use mathjs for computations. Bind targets in curly brackets {bindTarget}. Types: math (default), text, link, image. Write-to syntax: [math:writeTarget]. JS View Fields via meta-bind-js-view code blocks.
Reference docs show value: "=now()" with = prefix; official docs show plain JavaScript expressions without = prefix. Official docs are authoritative.
resolution: The = prefix is a Dataview convention, not Meta Bind syntax. Use plain JavaScript: value: "new Date().toISOString()"
